label: Unusual presentation of scleroderma: case report.
summary: The combination of neurological, cardiac, and pulmonary disease in patients with systemic sclerosis (SS) is rare. The aim of the study was to report a patient with SS who manifested with migraine without aura, Raynaud's phenomenon, pulmonary hypertension, and postural tachycardia syndrome (POTS), a combination which has not been previously reported. The patient is a 53-year-old Caucasian woman with diffuse cutaneous SS who was treated with methotrexate and developed migraine without aura since…
